name: cm Universal Trailing Stop Hedge
summary: This is a universal trailing stop utility for MetaTrader 5 that manages existing positions using seven different trailing algorithms: fixed points, fractals, ATR, Parabolic SAR, Moving Average, percentage of profit, and fixed pips. It supports both real SL modification and virtual trailing stop that closes positions when price hits the computed level, and provides visual chart labels and arrows for no-loss levels and stop levels.
summary_zh: 这是一个MetaTrader 5通用追踪止损工具，使用七种不同算法（固定点数、分形、ATR、抛物线SAR、均线、利润百分比、固定点）管理已有持仓的止损。支持真实止损修改和虚拟追踪止损（价格触及计算水平时平仓），并在图表上显示无亏损水平和止损水平的标签与箭头。
strategy_analysis: 此EA是一个纯工具型程序，不自行开仓，仅对已有持仓进行止损管理。策略概念是基于七种可选算法动态调整止损水平：1）按K线极值（最低价/最高价）加减偏移量设置止损；2）按分形结构（比尔·威廉姆斯分形）加减偏移量设置止损；3）按ATR指标值从当前价格回撤设置止损；4）按抛物线SAR指标值加减偏移量设置止损；5）按移动均线值加减偏移量设置止损；6）按利润百分比值设置止损；7）按固定点数从当前价格回撤设置止损。入场条件：无，EA不负责入场，仅管理已有持仓。出场条件：当价格触及追踪止损水平时平仓（虚拟模式）或修改SL至追踪水平（普通模式）。仓位管理：支持按魔术号筛选持仓，虚拟追踪止损模式下按整体多空加权均价计算止损水平。资金管理：无独立资金管理逻辑，止损追踪距离由参数delta、StepTrall、StartTrall控制。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a pure utility that does not open its own positions; it only manages stop loss levels for existing positions. The strategy concept is based on seven selectable algorithms for dynamically adjusting stop loss levels: 1) by candle extremes (low/high) plus a delta offset; 2) by Bill Williams fractal structures plus delta; 3) by ATR indicator value retraced from current price; 4) by Parabolic SAR value plus delta; 5) by Moving Average value plus delta; 6) by a percentage of current profit; 7) by a fixed pip distance from current price. Entry conditions: none — the EA does not handle entries, it only manages existing positions. Exit conditions: when price hits the trailing stop level, positions are closed (virtual mode) or SL is modified to the trailing level (normal mode). Position management: supports filtering positions by magic number; in virtual trailing mode, it calculates the weighted average price (no-loss level) for all buy and sell positions separately. Money management: no independent money management logic; trailing distance is controlled by the delta, StepTrall, and StartTrall parameters.

parameters.name: VirtualTrailingStop
parameters.description: 启用虚拟追踪止损（不修改真实SL，价格触及水平时直接平仓）
parameters.description_en: Enable virtual trailing stop (close on touch, no real SL modification)

parameters.name: parameters_trailing
parameters.description: 追踪止损算法类型：1=K线极值 2=分形 3=ATR 4=抛物线SAR 5=均线 6=利润百分比 7=固定点数
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop algorithm: 1=Bar extrema 2=Fractals 3=ATR 4=Parabolic SAR 5=MA 6=Profit% 7=Fixed points

parameters.name: delta
parameters.description: 止损偏移量（点数），加在指标计算值上
parameters.description_en: Stop loss offset in points, added to indicator value

parameters.name: TF_Tralling
parameters.description: 追踪止损使用的时间周期（0=当前周期）

parameters.name: StepTrall
parameters.description: 止损修改的最小步距（点数），避免频繁修改
parameters.description_en: Minimum step for SL modification in points

parameters.name: StartTrall
parameters.description: 开始追踪止损的盈利点数（距开仓价的点数）
parameters.description_en: Profit in points to start trailing stop

parameters.name: Step
parameters.description: 抛物线SAR步长参数（算法4使用）
parameters.description_en: Parabolic SAR step parameter (used by algorithm 4)

parameters.name: Maximum
parameters.description: 抛物线SAR最大值参数（算法4使用）
parameters.description_en: Parabolic SAR maximum parameter (used by algorithm 4)

parameters.name: Magic
parameters.description: 持仓魔术号筛选（-1=管理所有持仓）
parameters.description_en: Position magic number filter (-1=manage all positions)

parameters.name: GeneralNoLoss
parameters.description: 是否允许止损移至开仓价以上（无亏损保护）
parameters.description_en: Allow moving SL to breakeven (no-loss protection)

parameters.name: DrawArrow
parameters.description: 是否在图表上绘制止损水平箭头
parameters.description_en: Draw stop loss level arrows on chart

parameters.name: ma_period
parameters.description: 移动均线周期（算法5使用）

parameters.name: ma_method
parameters.description: 移动均线计算方法（算法5使用）
parameters.description_en: Moving average calculation method (used by algorithm 5)

parameters.name: applied_price
parameters.description: 移动均线应用价格类型（算法5使用）
parameters.description_en: Moving average applied price type (used by algorithm 5)

parameters.name: PercetnProfit
parameters.description: 利润百分比追踪止损值（算法6使用）
parameters.description_en: Profit percentage trailing stop value (used by algorithm 6)

pros: 提供七种不同的追踪止损算法，灵活性极高，适合各种交易风格
虚拟追踪止损模式可在经纪商限制SL修改时使用，且按加权均价计算整体仓位止损
提供丰富的图表视觉反馈（止损水平线、箭头、标签），方便实时监控止损状态
支持按魔术号筛选持仓，可与其他EA配合使用而不冲突
pros_en: Offers seven different trailing stop algorithms, providing extremely high flexibility for various trading styles
Virtual trailing stop mode works when brokers restrict SL modification, and calculates overall position stop based on weighted average price
Provides rich visual chart feedback (stop level lines, arrows, labels) for real-time monitoring of stop loss status
Supports position filtering by magic number, allowing conflict-free coexistence with other EAs
cons: 代码中存在严重BUG：第125行使用OrderGetInteger(ORDER_MAGIC)获取魔术号，但遍历的是持仓而非订单，应使用PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)
枚举变量名（b,c,d,e,f,g,i）极不语义化，可读性极差，维护困难
StrPer函数中多个时间周期映射错误（如H3映射为M3、H4映射为M4等）
虚拟追踪止损模式下缺少止损水平的STOPS_LEVEL校验，可能在实际交易中产生问题
SlLastBar函数中K线极值搜索循环（500根K线）效率低且无边界保护
cons_en: Critical bug on line 125: uses OrderGetInteger(ORDER_MAGIC) while iterating positions, should use PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) — this causes magic number filtering to fail entirely
Enum variable names (b,c,d,e,f,g,i) are extremely non-semantic, making the code nearly unreadable and hard to maintain
StrPer function has multiple timeframe mapping errors (e.g. H3 maps to M3, H4 maps to M4, etc.)
Virtual trailing stop mode lacks STOPS_LEVEL validation for the computed stop level, which may cause issues in live trading
The candle extreme search loop (500 bars) in SlLastBar is inefficient and lacks boundary protection
improvements: 修复魔术号获取BUG：将OrderGetInteger(ORDER_MAGIC)改为PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)，此为关键性错误
将枚举变量名从单字母改为语义化名称（如FIXED_POINTS、FRACTAL、ATR、PARABOLIC、MA、PERCENT_PROFIT、PIP_FIXED）
添加新K线检测逻辑，避免每个tick都执行所有计算和止损修改，减少资源消耗和交易服务器负担
修复StrPer函数中的时间周期映射错误，并添加对H3、H4、H6、H8、H12等时间周期的正确映射
improvements_en: Fix the magic number retrieval bug: change OrderGetInteger(ORDER_MAGIC) to PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) — this is a critical error that breaks magic number filtering
Rename enum values from single letters to semantic names (e.g. FIXED_POINTS, FRACTAL, ATR, PARABOLIC, MA, PERCENT_PROFIT, PIP_FIXED)
Add new bar detection logic to avoid executing all calculations and SL modifications on every tick, reducing resource consumption and trading server load
Fix the timeframe mapping errors in StrPer function and add correct mappings for H3, H4, H6, H8, H12 timeframes

risk_points: 魔术号筛选BUG导致所有持仓被管理而非仅指定魔术号的持仓，可能意外修改其他EA的止损
虚拟追踪止损模式下缺少订单发送前的OrderCheck校验（买入侧），可能导致无效订单请求
无新K线检测机制，每个tick都尝试修改止损，在高频行情下可能触发经纪商限制或被判定为滥用
止损水平未考虑点差和STOPS_LEVEL限制，虚拟模式可能在不利条件下平仓
risk_points_en: Magic number filtering bug causes all positions to be managed instead of only those with the specified magic number, potentially modifying other EAs' stop losses unintentionally
Virtual trailing stop mode lacks OrderCheck validation on the buy side before sending orders, which may result in invalid order requests
No new bar detection mechanism — every tick attempts SL modification, which may trigger broker restrictions or be flagged as abuse under high-frequency market conditions
Stop loss levels do not account for spread and STOPS_LEVEL limitations, and virtual mode may close positions under unfavorable conditions

It supports both real SL modification and virtual trailing stop that closes positions when price hits the computed level, and provides visual chart labels and arrows for no-loss levels and stop levels.
